registered_unplayed_notes.exact_control: Exact source/WASM equivalence control; no game was run.
registered_unplayed_notes.patch_combat_moves: Accidental candidate-name shadowing registration before games; preserved unbuilt/unplayed, excluded from tested candidates.

recovery_historical_harness_provenance: Qualified: one isolated contrary raw hash could not be reconstructed; archived before bytes agree with two earlier contemporaneous records. See immutable addendum/review; no continuously-identical historical harness-byte claim.

runtime_pins.engine_pin_limit: CLI has no engine-file option. Version is verified in final statistics; reference WASM is the official map-generator engine, not a claim of CLI engine injection.

limits: Unique physical inputs are exact ordered WASM/map/runtime/config/settings identities, not statistically independent games.
Cache reuse, duplicate smoke slots and panel reuse never add new evidence.
Imported old games may predate this experiment; their exact source cache hash, physical identity, statistics and retained replays are independently verified.
Quality counts include every physical input, including original-vs-spar baseline rows and either side.
Identity/quality audit success is not evidence of improvement. Publication still requires the separately recorded frozen confirmation gates.
SDK errors and low-fuel status are sampled logs, not exact native fuel-exhaustion counts.
Compact exports omit full raw statistics and native replay bulk; raw SHA256 pins remain, and full local evidence is retained.
Completed-stage snapshot can exclude concurrently running/newly published stages; snapshot_is_final is false when a planned stage is pending.
